name: GetLoadBalancer
label: Get AWS ELB Load Balancer
description: Retrieves details of an Application or Network Load Balancer in AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB).

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: LoadBalancerArn
fields.label: Load Balancer ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the load balancer to retrieve.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the load balancer is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: LoadBalancerDetails
fields.label: Load Balancer Details
fields.description: Details of the retrieved load balancer (ARN, DNS name, state, etc.).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS ELB.
